admin.partnersDesc: Partners onboard customers on their own sites via Partner API. Members who sign up on ICOCARD /register can also issue and run cards. Both channels are supported.
admin.confirmRegister: Register with the information you entered?
admin.confirmRegisterAgain: Please confirm once more. Proceed with registration?
admin.apiKeySave: Store this value securely. It will not be shown again.
admin.confirmRegen: The current API key will be invalidated immediately. Issue a new key?
admin.feePerPartner: Applies only to this partner. Saved rates stay independent of the global defaults.
admin.settingsDesc: Sandbox and Production are separate. Production needs your client_id/secret and chain 8453. Helper API is Sandbox only.
admin.clientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the current secret
admin.feesDesc: These values apply to direct users and to partners without custom rates. Set per-partner fees in Partner API. Fees go to the treasury wallet.
admin.useMock: Use mock mode (simulate instead of live API)
admin.orgDesc: Same as ICOPAY/PG: Headquarters > Regional HQ > Master distributor > Branch > Agency > Sales office > Partner. A unit that onboards a partner earns a share of those fees.
admin.feePolicyDesc: Default merchant fees and sales-org split. Per-merchant rates can still be set when registering a partner.
admin.distFeesDesc: Share of collected fees paid to each level on the merchant parent chain. Remainder goes to Headquarters.
admin.merchantRegDesc: Same as PG org registration: company profile, representative ID, and password. The company receives a login account.
admin.orgRegSameAsMerchant: Same basic info and representative ID/password as company registration. Password must be reset on first login.
admin.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
admin.basicHint: The company code is assigned only when you save (2-letter prefix by level + 8-digit sequence) and cannot be changed afterward. The same code appears in the company list. Selecting a level shows the matching fields. Organizations can only move upward (not downward); all children move with them. Setting unused also sets all children unused; a partner can be reactivated individually by changing its parent. Enter the password, confirm with [Save] next to the field, then register with [Save] at the bottom. If you forget the password after registration, reset it in [Company lookup] or [Company info], then sign in with login ID + 1! and change it.
admin.parentSearchHint: Click a row to select it as the parent company
admin.zipSearchHintJp: Search by postal code or place name.
admin.zipSearchFail: Could not open postal code search.
admin.orgLoginIssued: Give the login ID and API key to the company. They must set a new password on first login.
admin.issueStoppedHint: When issuance is stopped, virtual and physical cards cannot be issued.
admin.operatorsHqDesc: Operators who sign in to the HQ admin site. Not card holders.
admin.operatorsPartnerDesc: Operators for partner admin. Not card holders.
admin.membersDirectDesc: Card holders who signed up at ICOCARD /register.
admin.membersPartnerDesc: Card holders created through Partner API.
admin.brandLead: White-label brand. Change name, logos and colors without touching issuer integration.
admin.feeTemplatesDesc: Create HQ default and extra policies. Partners without a selection follow HQ. Partner-level edits take priority.
admin.feeDirectHint: If you choose Enter manually, the fees below apply and take priority over HQ settings.
admin.directMemberDesc: Direct members sign up at /register. Partner members are created by merchant API. Direct members can issue and top up cards.
admin.otpPolicyDesc: Require Google OTP for admin, member, and partner logins (Crypto standard).
admin.resetOtpConfirm: Reset Google OTP for {email}?\n(They must re-enroll on next login)

partner.scamBody: There have been cases of people impersonating headquarters or the platform to request money. We never ask for separate payment-related funds. If you receive a suspicious contact, confirm it with customer support or your contracted sales office.
partner.setPasswordHint: This is your first login. Set the password you will use.
partner.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
partner.apiHint: Call card and wallet APIs from your merchant site using headers.
partner.manual1: HQ registers the company and shares the API key.
partner.manual2: HQ creates a partner user under User accounts.
partner.manual3: Review API, fees, and this manual in the portal.
partner.manual4: Issue cards on your site with X-API-Key and X-Partner-User-Id.
